status: Software and CAD verified; hardware qualification outstanding

checks.scope: Seven function groups retained; 69.5% smaller than the original 160 × 100 mm carrier. Two copper layers, four ready modules, seven fitted headers, three diodes and two resistors. J8/J9 are unpopulated recovery pads. No female sockets.
Final native schematic and routed PCB; clean reproduction from generator, committed SES and manual route passed. Module terminals do not validate internal circuits.

checks.result: 20 tests passed; independent audit of 133 pads and 31 net groups passed
checks.scope: 101 connected endpoints; 13 intentional corruptions detected. Bottom-edge RJ45; H2 antenna beyond carrier FR4. USB cable corridors removed; physical shells, narrow header housings and nylon supports checked geometrically. Actual fit remains untested.
21 S3 GPIOs; shared W5500/CC1101 SPI; three UARTs; MG24 flow control; power isolation; H2 ROM UART23/24; unpopulated recovery pads and fitted count.

checks.result: Compiled: 1,731,456-byte OTA image; 163,795 bytes static RAM
checks.scope: ESPHome 2026.9.1 / IDF 5.5.5. Nano 16 MB flash, 8 MB octal PSRAM and three active BLE slots. Each OTA slot has 6,395,008 bytes of margin. Static RAM is not runtime free heap.

checks.check: Bounded Thread recovery, transport and radio update tooling
checks.result: 55 ASan / UBSan host tests and 2 REST client tests passed
checks.scope: RCP preflight, durable quarantine, explicit maintenance, authenticated temporary H2 UART session, image/partition checks and binary localhost tunnel. Pinned host dependencies install cleanly; both real radio images pass offline planning. Physical updates, power-loss and concurrent-load behavior remain untested.

checks.result: Rebuilt and verified: 208,928 bytes; RX23 / TX24
checks.scope: IDF 5.5.5 RCP uses the same pins as the ROM loader. H2 DevKitM-1 v1.3 R7 removal is required to isolate CP2102N TX; verify the purchased revision and continuity. Initial programming uses native USB J4 before assembly.

checks.result: Retained verified build; 9 recipe/image tests passed
checks.scope: SiSDK 2025.6.3 / EmberZNet 8.2.3 / EZSP18 image unchanged. Pairing and network restore still require hardware validation.
